test_title: PYST 26: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a631747dc01ed32aa42181be5dfcfb7d7ba71b309317af4095babc88b9fc8403.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I:- The alphabets is getting shifted one place in anti-clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e40202b1668cbe5fd58bf287274dd98f3e980fafd365b17d8080d87e2818d1c.png] 

Step II:- The numbers are getting shifted one place in anticlockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10b323d30ee6e7e4ca4658958ec5b7b4d1281908a98fa6b2a26135472e2bcd43.png] 

So, the series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f338aea4048f7a4b9b68e8c5636a05ec60d05ead75f7a5496ed85a572239e7c7.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
